policy: Use only these five participants. Include the payer in a split if they consumed the item.
Split confirmed shared expenses equally among explicitly confirmed consumers.
For itemized meals, split each category among its confirmed consumers. Drinks-only diners do not share food.

Explicit first-hand accounts of a shared expense or an itemized receipt can confirm participation. Uncertain third-party attendance reports require confirmation; paying alone does not prove attendance.
Merge sources only when payer, amount, currency, date and expense context identify the same expense. Equal amounts alone do not imply duplicates.
Use the stated USD conversion rate for this fictional workshop, not a live exchange rate.
Exclude any expense whose exact amount, payer or participant set remains unresolved. Ask a source-linked question; never estimate or silently assume.
Convert each ledger row to paise with ROUND_HALF_UP. Allocate weighted shares by largest remainder; ties follow participants order.
Balances from confirmed items are provisional until the group answers all questions and approves the settlement.
Do not modify input files, contact anyone or initiate payments.
